question_text: Observation(DeviceID, TechnicianID, RecordedAt, DeviceModel, Reading) has composite primary key (DeviceID, TechnicianID, RecordedAt). DeviceID determines DeviceModel. Outline why it is not in 2NF.
adaptation_rationale: Partial functional dependency and 2NF explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: DeviceModel is a non-key attribute depending only on DeviceID, a proper subset of the composite key. This partial dependency violates 2NF.

marking_points.criterion: Explains non-key attribute depends on only part of the composite key, violating 2NF.
